title: Funding Standing in Early Termination — Paystride Payroll Card Program Risk Ruling
content:
**Ruling.** For a Paystride Payroll Card Program, the prorated early termination fee is multiplied for the program's funding standing, counting the reinstatement fees debited in the termination look-back less the reinstatement fees credited in it, the termination look-back holding the funding entries dated today or earlier that lie fewer than twelve whole months before today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's:

| Reinstatement fees in the look-back, less those credited | Multiplier of the prorated fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.5 |
| exactly one | 1.25 |
| none | none — the prorated fee is not multiplied for funding standing |

**Grounds read.** Reinstatement fee entries and credits of reinstatement fees in the program's funding history, each counted by its own entry date.

### Hypothetical cases (today being 7 March)

- Reinstatement fees dated 8 March and 30 September of the previous year: both lie fewer than twelve whole months back; the count is two and the multiplier 1.5.
- A reinstatement fee dated 7 March of the previous year lies twelve whole months back and is not counted.
- One reinstatement fee in the look-back, credited back in it: the count is none.

A prorated fee of 312.40 multiplied by 1.25 is 390.50, and multiplied by 1.5 it is 468.60.
